# Day-12 offline research (2026-10-07)

Scratch-level scripts kept for reproducibility; results are summarised in `daily/plans/d12.md`.
- `fl_variants.py` + `fl_variants_bootstrap.py`: protocol-matched FL aggregations on the expert sets (rejected).
- `mt_edge_ab.py`, `telemed_edge_*`: blind A/B of aponeurosis inner edges, pipeline vs the edges implied by the
  reference MT, on 5 Telemed clips (pipeline picked 5/5).
